name: waterfall
description: Waterfall — Ultra-lightweight IDM & JDownloader modern hybrid download suite

scripts.stamp: node -e "const { rcedit } = require('rcedit'); rcedit('node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe', { icon: 'assets/icon.ico', 'version-string': { ProductName: 'Waterfall', FileDescription: 'Waterfall Download Suite' } }).then(() => console.log('Icon stamped successfully')).catch(console.error);"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const { rcedit } = require('rcedit'); rcedit('node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe', { icon: 'assets/icon.ico', 'version-string': { ProductName: 'Waterfall', FileDescription: 'Waterfall Download Suite' } }); } catch (_) {}"
